verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an official Gmail REST API you can build against: the messages.send endpoint, push notifications and OAuth scopes. Nothing in the pack mentions official client libraries or SDKs, so developers may have to call raw REST endpoints and hand-encode base64URL MIME messages. Probes for llms.txt and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec both returned 404. Missing for 10: any evidence of official language SDKs/client libraries, SDK docs or quickstarts, a published OpenAPI spec for codegen, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
